summary: Corticeira Amorim, S.G.P.S., S.A. engages in the acquisition and transformation of cork into various cork and cork-related products in Portugal, Switzerland, Norway, the rest of the European Union, the rest of Europe, the United States, the rest of the American countries, Australasia, and Africa. It operates through Amorim Florestal, Amorim Cork, Amorim Cork Solutions, and Corticeira Amorim and Others segments. The company is involved in the procurement, sourcing, purchase, stocking, and preparation of cork as a raw material; the production, supply, and distribution of cork stoppers; and the development of solutions with cork composites for various industries, including aerospace, maritime, mobility, sealing, energy, construction, flooring, sports surfaces, playgrounds, toys, home, office, and leisure. It also provides floor and wall covering materials, as well as insulation and energy-efficient composite cork for use in structures and buildings. The company's cork products are used for still and sparkling wines and spirits, architecture and design, infrastructure, sports, and other applications. The company was founded in 1870 and is based in Mozelos, Portugal. Corticeira Amorim, S.G.P.S., S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Amorim Investimentos e Participações, S.G.P.S., S.A.
